features.name: url_identity_obfuscation_score
features.description: Normalized severity of URL identity hiding cues: numeric IP host, shortening service, at sign, double slash redirecting, prefix or suffix dash, and https token misuse. Higher values indicate more obfuscation cues in the row.
features.expected_model_benefit: Dense average of several sparse URL flags gives a margin model a stable linear axis instead of many isolated binary jumps.

features.name: url_shape_complexity_score
features.description: Weighted shape severity for long or ambiguous URL length, complex subdomain pattern, abnormal URL relation, and redirect count.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures gradual structural complexity with weights that can align with a linear separator.
features.formula: 0.35 * np.where(((url_length == -1) | (url_length == '-1')), 1.0, np.where(((url_length == 0) | (url_length == '0')), 0.5, 0.0)) + 0.25 * np.where(((having_sub_domain == -1) | (having_sub_domain == '-1')), 1.0, np.where(((having_sub_domain == 0) | (having_sub_domain == '0')), 0.5, 0.0)) + 0.20 * np.where(((abnormal_url == -1) | (abnormal_url == '-1')), 1.0, 0.0) + 0.20 * np.where(((redirect == 1) | (redirect == '1')), 1.0, 0.0)

features.name: security_claim_mismatch_score
features.description: Interaction score that rises when weak SSL state appears together with HTTPS-token misuse, abnormal URL relation, or double-slash redirecting.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a fixed nonlinear cross-cue projection while keeping the resulting value smooth and normalized for SVM margins.

features.name: domain_maturity_deficit_score
features.description: Weighted deficit score for certificate state, short registration length, young domain age, missing DNS record, and subdomain complexity.
features.expected_model_benefit: Condenses several domain trust signals into one calibrated axis that reduces collinearity among related inputs.
features.formula: 0.30 * np.where(((sslfinal_state == -1) | (sslfinal_state == '-1')), 1.0, np.where(((sslfinal_state == 0) | (sslfinal_state == '0')), 0.5, 0.0)) + 0.25 * np.where(((domain_registeration_length == -1) | (domain_registeration_length == '-1')), 1.0, 0.0) + 0.20 * np.where(((age_of_domain == -1) | (age_of_domain == '-1')), 1.0, 0.0) + 0.15 * np.where(((dnsrecord == -1) | (dnsrecord == '-1')), 1.0, 0.0) + 0.10 * np.where(((having_sub_domain == -1) | (having_sub_domain == '-1')), 1.0, np.where(((having_sub_domain == 0) | (having_sub_domain == '0')), 0.5, 0.0))

features.name: content_link_anomaly_score
features.description: Severity of suspicious page references using request URL, anchor URL, links in tags, server form handler, and favicon source cues.
features.expected_model_benefit: Combines link-distribution signals into a continuous score suited to a linear coefficient.
features.formula: 0.25 * np.where(((request_url == -1) | (request_url == '-1')), 1.0, 0.0) + 0.25 * np.where(((url_of_anchor == -1) | (url_of_anchor == '-1')), 1.0, np.where(((url_of_anchor == 0) | (url_of_anchor == '0')), 0.5, 0.0)) + 0.20 * np.where(((links_in_tags == -1) | (links_in_tags == '-1')), 1.0, np.where(((links_in_tags == 0) | (links_in_tags == '0')), 0.5, 0.0)) + 0.20 * np.where(((sfh == -1) | (sfh == '-1')), 1.0, np.where(((sfh == 0) | (sfh == '0')), 0.5, 0.0)) + 0.10 * np.where(((favicon == -1) | (favicon == '-1')), 1.0, 0.0)

features.name: credential_capture_surface_score
features.description: Composite measure of credential or form-capture surface from form handler, email submission, iframe, popup window, request URL, and anchor URL fields.
features.expected_model_benefit: Projects several form and embedding cues onto a single severity direction that can improve margin stability.
features.formula: 0.30 * np.where(((sfh == -1) | (sfh == '-1')), 1.0, np.where(((sfh == 0) | (sfh == '0')), 0.5, 0.0)) + 0.20 * np.where(((submitting_to_email == -1) | (submitting_to_email == '-1')), 1.0, 0.0) + 0.15 * np.where(((iframe == -1) | (iframe == '-1')), 1.0, 0.0) + 0.15 * np.where(((popupwidnow == -1) | (popupwidnow == '-1')), 1.0, 0.0) + 0.10 * np.where(((request_url == -1) | (request_url == '-1')), 1.0, 0.0) + 0.10 * np.where(((url_of_anchor == -1) | (url_of_anchor == '-1')), 1.0, np.where(((url_of_anchor == 0) | (url_of_anchor == '0')), 0.5, 0.0))

features.name: browser_interference_score
features.description: Severity of browser interaction interference from mouseover status changes, right click blocking, popup window behavior, and iframe use.
features.expected_model_benefit: Averaging sparse script-behavior flags gives a smoother input than separate low-frequency indicators.

features.name: external_reputation_deficit_score
features.description: External visibility and reputation deficit using web traffic, page rank, search index, inbound-link, and statistical report fields.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a broad popularity and reputation projection with smooth partial credit for middle states.
features.formula: 0.25 * np.where(((web_traffic == -1) | (web_traffic == '-1')), 1.0, np.where(((web_traffic == 0) | (web_traffic == '0')), 0.5, 0.0)) + 0.20 * np.where(((page_rank == -1) | (page_rank == '-1')), 1.0, 0.0) + 0.20 * np.where(((google_index == -1) | (google_index == '-1')), 1.0, 0.0) + 0.15 * np.where(((links_pointing_to_page == -1) | (links_pointing_to_page == '-1')), 1.0, np.where(((links_pointing_to_page == 0) | (links_pointing_to_page == '0')), 0.5, 0.0)) + 0.20 * np.where(((statistical_report == -1) | (statistical_report == '-1')), 1.0, 0.0)

features.name: rare_abuse_signal_density
features.description: Density of high-impact abuse indicators drawn from right-click blocking, redirects, iframes, nonstandard ports, double-slash redirecting, and email submission.
features.expected_model_benefit: Gives the SVM a compact sparse-alert count that is less noisy than any single flag.
